by: Fable agent (claude-fable-5-1), delegated by a Claude Code session for Luke Randall

results.note: Fixed. Flattened types set about = None, and the nodoc program shows no stray text.
Partly fixed. Debug builds warn, and check_examples and check_recoveries fail in CI. Release builds still drop Next: lines silently.
Fixed. #[derive(Failure)] with forward keys replaces the hand-written methods. Failure is still not found through source(), and the docs now state that as a rule.
Partly fixed. Error::unclassified wraps any error and documents a downcast pattern for anyhow. Every miette::Report still maps to one code.
Fixed. The refusals print in crumbkit's wording with a help line and the code crumbkit::cli::usage.
Unchanged. Six shelf goldens hold clap sentences, and clap_complete is pinned to ~4.6.11.
Fixed. docs/tutorial.md has five steps, and a test fails when its code drifts from the example files.
Partly fixed. Pages::clap() lets seven checks run without crumbkit's runtime, but check_names and check_grammar still take &Guide, and crumbkit-test still builds all of crumbkit.
Unchanged. Both are still non-optional dependencies.
Fixed. crumbkit-usage holds the log behind crumbkit::events::Observer. The seam is one global slot, and the first observer installed wins.
Fixed. crumbkit-child holds hand_over, and crumbkit has no child module.
The budget and batches are still in crumbkit.

setup: The agent extracted commits 1013fe2 and 514e3d0 with git archive into a scratch directory. It rebuilt the README example on both trees, plus a clap-only equivalent, with one measurement script. It ran the workspace tests and doctests on 514e3d0, and built two small programs (nodoc, forgot) to exercise the rough-edge cases. The start and finish times are taken from the scratch files' timestamps.
summary: Seven of the twelve cases pass, against one in the first run. Three of the failing cases are partly fixed. The workspace tests pass. The build cost did not fall: the cold build is about 1.6 times the clap-only build, and the binary is 0.76 MB larger. The public function count rose from 272 to 311. CHANGELOG.md still lists the removed usage-log and hand-over features under Added. crumbkit is worth adopting for agent-first resource/verb tools that run crumbkit-test in CI, and a plain clap tool can now use crumbkit-test's clap-only checks as a dev-dependency.
